summary: A Best Current Practice describing how to stop default-configured recursive name servers from being used as reflectors in denial of service attacks. It recommends configuration measures to reduce the attack. An attacker can make such servers send large replies to a victim, so limiting who may ask them helps.

eli5.summary: If a shop answers any stranger's question, a bully could trick it into shouting answers at someone else. This says to answer only your own customers.
